Specification: This module specifies an abstract asynchronous termination detection problem for a ring of N nodes. Each node has an activation status and a count of pending messages, and the system tracks whether global termination has been detected; nodes may terminate, send messages, receive messages, and detection may occur once all nodes are inactive and have no pending messages. The specification checks safety and liveness style properties, including that detection implies actual termination, that termination is stable once reached, and that actual termination leads to eventual detection under a weak fairness assumption for the DetectTermination action; it also includes auxiliary invariants and a state constraint for bounded model checking.
